Context: T. A. when deputed for training

6. Officials deputed for training to the institutions which are located within the Urban Agglomeration of Government servant's headquarters
- are not entitled to any T.A. / D.A. irrespective of the distance.  
- GIO (1), SR 164 and GIO (3) SR 71.
